wrap_model_for_ddp_training: wrap a PyTorch model with DistributedDataParallel for c10d or pytorch_ddp backend training
wrap_model_for_fully_sharded_training: wrap a model with FullyShardedDataParallel for fully_sharded backend distributed training
configure_ddp_bucket_and_buffers: configure DDP bucket capacity and buffer broadcasting when wrapping a model for distributed training
apply_mixed_precision_to_sharded_model: apply bfloat16 or half precision to a fully sharded model when memory_efficient_fp16 is enabled
review_DistributedModel: review the DistributedModel function to understand how it wraps models for c10d and fully_sharded backends
